answer_1.quote: We consider Knowledge Graph-to-Text (KG-to-Text) generation where the task consists of verbalising the content of a KG ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated Russian textual descriptions from knowledge graphs

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we use the following metrics: BLEU score, chrF++, TER score and BERT score.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a human evaluation on the three best performing models... The annotators are then asked to answer the following four questions about the three texts: • Please, select the text which is the closest to the data shown. • Please, select the text which is the farthest from the data shown. • Please, select the text which is the most fluent. • Please, select the text which is the least fluent.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank each of the three generated texts based on (i) closeness to the data (additions/omissions) and (ii) fluency, using the four questions above.
